title: From your Maxim production failures to regression tests
subtitle: Pull the traces Maxim flagged in production, see them grouped by how they failed, and turn each group into a task your agent must pass before the next release.

steps.pull: Pull failures from your Maxim log repository
steps.cluster: See them grouped by failure mode
steps.draft: Draft one task per group, with generated checks
steps.ready: Run the readiness check, then the task joins your evaluations

notConnected: Maxim is not connected. Connect your log repository in Settings first; the API key stays in the org key store.
connectedTo: Connected to log repository {{repo}} in workspace {{workspace}}

filter.title: Which traces failed
filter.description: Any trace that matches one rule is taken. Every trace is redacted before it is stored.
filter.evaluatorsHint: Online evaluator names, comma separated, as Maxim shows them
filter.needRule: Pick at least one rule: failed evaluators, errored traces or a score threshold.

imports.title: Imports
imports.empty: No import yet. Pull failures above to start.

truncated: The import stopped at its trace limit. Pull again with a narrower window to see the rest.

clusters.title: Failure groups
clusters.description: Traces that failed the same way: the same failing tool and error, or the same failing evaluator.
clusters.empty: No failures matched. Try a longer window or another evaluator.

tasks.title: Tasks waiting for review
tasks.description: Generated checks never count until a person accepts them. A task that is not accepted is never used in an evaluation.
tasks.empty: No task drafted yet. Pick groups above and draft tasks.
tasks.recorded: What the agent answered in production
tasks.answerHint: One short line is matched exactly; several lines are facts the answer must all contain.
tasks.rejectReason: Why it is not a task
